name: meteors
title: Meteors
description: A looping shower of thin diagonal light streaks that fall across whatever container it sits in, usually a dark card. It adds slow night-sky motion behind the text.
use: A dark card or panel needs quiet continuous motion to feel alive without competing with its text.
avoid: Light or busy backgrounds: the pale grey streaks disappear and the night-sky mood is lost.
a11y: The streaks are decorative but not marked aria-hidden, and the loop keeps running under reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark, softly rounded card on black with a blurred blue-teal halo leaking out behind its lower edge. Inside sit a small ring icon, a bold white heading, two grey lines of copy and a thin outlined Explore button, crossed by a few pale diagonal streaks.
behaves: Around twenty thin streaks enter from the top of the card at randomised delays and speeds, drift down-left and fade out near the bottom, looping forever. The whole layer fades in once when it mounts.
customise: number sets how many streaks run and className adds utility classes. Streak colour, thickness, angle and the five-second loop are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Up to twenty one-pixel spans on a CSS loop inside a single fading wrapper.
